sources.quote: COAT-ZN-YELLOW,Zinc 8 um with yellow chromate passivation,Zinc;CrVI
so a coating containing hexavalent chromium may not be used on our parts

findings.why: Yellow chromate passivation on zinc (COAT-ZN-YELLOW) contains hexavalent chromium, which is banned in the EU market where PRG-X and PRG-Y are sold. The ELV Annex II exemption has expired. The ban continues under Regulation (EU) 2026/1738.

sources.quote: or change of coating or surface treatment.
Aurelia shall be notified of every planned change at least 90 days before implementation.

findings.why: CL-115 is used on PRG-X (Aurelia). Revision 4 of the Aurelia manual replaces revision 3. It requires written approval (PPAP resubmission) for a coating change, and 90 days' notice. Nothing in force covers this change.

sources.quote: 5.2 A change of coating requires Nordhavn approval before the first shipment.

findings.why: CL-115 is also used on PRG-Y (Nordhavn). A coating change needs Nordhavn approval before the first shipment, and nothing in force covers it.

sources.quote: Lot 26-0412 of CL-115 clips in C67S spring steel measured 52 HRC, tolerance 44-50 HRC.

findings.why: SUP-G is the source of CL-115 and has an open NCR on the C67S spring steel of this part.
